sources.researchNote: The record gives birth on 3 April 1890 in Saint Petersburg and death on 31 December 1969 at Hergenrath, Belgium, and describes him as a poet, stage and film director and collector of art and books, with Landau, Constantin as the French form of his name. It links him to the film Madame ne veut pas d’enfants, which identifies him as the director of that film. Consulted through the BnF SRU service and the catalogue page.
